foundations.rationale: The About cards explain implemented systems and acknowledge model limits; the owner-selected width schematic is documented without institutional claims.

copy.rationale: About Gradient now explicitly distinguishes halving light values from logarithmic display widths, and identifies the schematic limitation. Other requested descriptions and source credits are preserved. Full Naming and Voice & Tone sources remain the basis.

interface.rationale: Gradient returns to Static with only its variant control: Loop, Speed, Reverse and GIF are removed. Legacy motion fields cannot revive animation. Keyboard/390px layout, Randomize/Undo/reset and actual SVG/PNG downloads pass in Chromium and WebKit. Other changed cards retain the earlier focused coverage.

bar-and-exports.rationale: The owner rejected the literal-width/compressed-gap candidate and requested static, logical, readable artwork. Twenty-one relative light levels 2^-n span 20 stops; a documented log2(1 + I/Imin) width display makes them readable. Fixed evenly spaced centers use natural endpoint tangency. No opacity blending, edge strips, fitting, new asset or calibrated measurement is claimed. Preview/header/SVG/PNG/Home share static geometry; legacy phases are ignored and GIF is unavailable.

media.rationale: Read all contextual media sources. Only two existing Gradient SVG samples and original application review captures change. No production video, photo, audio, seal or spirit mark is introduced; their permissions and video typography conflict remain outside this change.

assets-and-approvals.rationale: Read asset_licensing.md and its actual unresolved permission records. Gradient samples are original software-authored rectangles, not copied Xyla artwork. Screenshots reuse existing project assets. No fonts, logos, external artwork or licenses are added or replaced; existing redistribution questions remain open.

governance.rationale: Read all 17 captured pages and source coverage/manifest. Record the owner’s narrowly scoped November 18 product decision in brand_conflicts.md without altering official sources, checks or claiming formal approval.
